en.title: Maximize the Power
en.description:
The power array has even length. In each operation, pick any two of its position values x and y, gain the sum of the closed interval arr[min(x,y)..max(x,y)], and then remove these two elements from power. Maximize the total gain after all operations, modulo 10^9+7.

The explicit standard input/output format and supplementary constraints on this site belong to the online version and are not presented as the original source constraints.
en.input: The input contains N and K, then N non-negative arr values, then K positions. This site adds 1≤N≤200000, 2≤K≤2000 with K even, every position in [0,N−1], and arr[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output the maximum total gain modulo 10^9+7.
en.explanation: Sort the power positions and use prefix sums to compute each interval's contribution; pair positions from both ends inward.
